pre_result_amendment.reason: The shared adapter incorrectly used executor reached/progressed/stopped feedback to roll back the frozen DynaMAC clock and delay its gripper command, changing the baseline rather than merely sharing its IK executor.
pre_result_amendment.resolution: Restore one fixed-clock advance per formally committed DynaMAC transaction and authorize its own gripper command independently of the Cartesian reached envelope; closed-loop posterior and boundary semantics are unchanged.

pre_result_amendment_2.reason: The closed-loop boundary transaction captured the target-skill virtual frame from the pre-action pose, one cycle earlier than the frozen DynaMAC terminal bridge semantics. This caused systematic OpenMicrowave degradation across all three closed-loop ablations.
pre_result_amendment_2.resolution: Execute the source terminal continuous target with the committed entry gripper, then capture the target-skill virtual frame from the next post-action observation. The relation, progress, boundary-guard, recovery, task set, sample set, fault protocol, and statistical plan are unchanged.
pre_result_amendment_2.invalidated_attempt_disposition: All partial results produced before this repair are excluded from statistics and removed from the formal result root before restart.

pre_result_amendment_3.reason: Four reproducible full-only PlaceCups failures in the early normal matrix reached valid recovery geometry but were rejected because event expansion and reentry compared raw overlap with a soft relation prior directly against a fixed absolute threshold.
pre_result_amendment_3.resolution: Thresholded state eligibility now uses peak-normalized soft-prior support together with uncompensated external/linked direction consistency. Raw relation overlap remains unchanged in the progress posterior, and no task-specific branch or additional gate was introduced.
pre_result_amendment_3.invalidated_attempt_disposition: All incomplete results produced before this repair are excluded from statistics and removed from the formal result root before restart.

implementation_correction_after_invalida.observed_audit_scope: 19 of 32 normal cells completed; the entire attempt is invalidated
implementation_correction_after_invalida.reason: The relation likelihood geometrically multiplied translation and rotation component evidence. During a normal Handover grasp, compliant rotational contact wobble could therefore veto clear translational co-motion, falsely classify an intact link as external, and trigger destructive LINK recovery.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.resolution: Marginalize finite per-component likelihoods with weights proportional to the actually observed action component magnitude. This introduces no state, task branch, threshold, or fitted parameter; single-component excitation is unchanged and sustained all-component mismatch remains external evidence.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.invalidated_attempt_disposition: All results and diagnostics from the audit attempt are excluded from statistics and moved out of the formal result root before a complete restart from the repaired commit.

implementation_correction_after_invalida.observed_audit_scope: approximately 545 normal episodes completed before the incomplete attempt was stopped and invalidated
implementation_correction_after_invalida.reason: A PyRep planned path removes its Reflexxes motion handle only when the full path completes. The shared Stage-six executor intentionally returns after a bounded raw-physics budget, so an unfinished planned-path prefix could be discarded without releasing its simulator-owned handle.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.resolution: Release every unfinished planned-path motion handle at the bounded controller ownership boundary before returning reached, progressed, stopped, or an exception. This changes only executor resource lifetime; StateId, progress, relation, role, boundary, recovery, task set, sample set, fault protocol, and statistical plan are unchanged.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.invalidated_attempt_disposition: The incomplete attempt is excluded from all statistics and moved out of the formal result root before restart from the repaired commit.

implementation_correction_after_invalida.observed_audit_scope: 2511 of 6400 normal episodes and 10 complete cells; the entire attempt is invalidated
implementation_correction_after_invalida.reason: Reentry selection evaluated a candidate with that candidate's relation prior, but alignment action routing reused the frozen fault-state beta and could therefore block the selected candidate with stale relation semantics.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.resolution: Route only the read-only alignment action with a candidate-conditioned progress view. The real beta, StateId, reference_state, mode, role history, task clock, candidates, thresholds, and atomic reentry criteria remain frozen and unchanged.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.invalidated_attempt_disposition: All results and diagnostics from the audit attempt are excluded from statistics and moved out of the formal result root before a complete restart from the repaired commit.

implementation_correction_after_invalida.observed_audit_scope: 4737 of 6400 normal episodes and 19 complete cells; the entire attempt is invalidated
implementation_correction_after_invalida.reason: A pending relation could satisfy the visibility, tracking, uncertainty, and retry prerequisites while the recent TASK trajectory had no estimable nonzero approach direction. VERIFY_LINK then entered even though its fixed reverse-probe template was undefined and raised an unhandled policy exception.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.resolution: Treat availability of the existing approach direction as an inherent VERIFY_LINK entry prerequisite. If the recent actual TASK trajectory is stationary, insufficient, or has near-zero net displacement, remain in TASK/HOLD and let the existing nominal or mismatch-recovery chain continue; no state, threshold, task branch, relation model, or recovery target is added.
implementation_correction_after_invalida.invalidated_attempt_disposition: All results and diagnostics from the incomplete audit attempt are excluded from statistics and moved out of the formal result root before a complete restart from the repaired commit.
